title: openOODA CLI
content:
## What it is

`ooda` is the command-line workflow driver. It dispatches to the compiler (`oodac`), the package manager (`opm`), the language server (`lsp`), the MCP server (`mcp`), and runs scripts via the toolchain.

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://openooda.org/install.sh | bash
```

## Surface

13 subcommands, dispatched by `cli/main.oo`:

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `ooda build` | Build a `.oo` source to a target (ELF, WASM, C99, LLVM IR) |
| `ooda run` | Compile and execute a `.oo` source |
| `ooda gen` | Generate code (AST → target) without executing |
| `ooda test` | Run tests (with sequential double-run invariant) |
| `ooda install` | Install the toolchain or a package |
| `ooda bench` | Run benchmarks |
| `ooda init` | Initialize a new project |
| `ooda context` | Inspect context (LLM-facing: token budget, caps, audit) |
| `ooda health` | Server health check |
| `ooda fix` | Auto-repair a `.oo` source file (adversarial repair) |
| `ooda digest` | Compute the Merkle digest of a source tree |
| `ooda fmt` | Format a `.oo` source file |
| `ooda token` | 12 token sub-subcommands (issue, attenuate, verify, etc.) |

Plus spawned subcommands: `opm`, `lsp`, `mcp` (delegated to those repos).

Env vars: `OODA_REPO_ROOT`, `OODA_FS_WRITEDIR`, `OODA_CACHE`, `OODA_TOOLCHAIN`, `OODA_PROFILE`. Flags: `-h`, `-v`, `--strict`, `-O<0|1|2|3>`, `--target=<elf|wasm|c99|llvm>`.

## Version contract

```
cli=2.11.0
oooda=2.10.0
ooda_max=2.99.0
oodac=2.10.0
```

See `openOODA/cli/docs/` for the full reference: `CLI_SETUP.oot`, `argv.oot`, `dispatch.oot`, `COMMANDS.oot`, `ENV.oot`.
